description: Lawyers and law firms listed in the FindLaw directory for a practice area in a US city: name, firm or attorney, phone, street address, website, rating and review count, firm of an attorney, profile link. Reads the structured data on FindLaw's public city page (first page only, ~20-40 of totalListed, in FindLaw order incl. sponsored placement). A directory listing is not proof of a bar licence; check the state bar. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_governmentbids when you need Open US/Canadian government bid solicitations listed; gov_clinicaltrials when you need ClinicalTrials.gov studies matching a condition, drug. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

practiceArea.description: FindLaw practice slug, e.g. bankruptcy-law, family-law, criminal-law, personal-injury-plaintiff, immigration-law, estate-planning

state.description: US state name, e.g. texas, new-york
